duration.text: The Linguistics and Applied Linguistics at Harbin Normal University is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2916 USD/per year ￥ 21000 CNY/per year

materials.text: Health certificate Photocopy of notarized foreigner physical examination record (for durations of study over 6 months) Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant Master's degree diploma Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. Letter of recommendation From professor or associate professor or equivalents Permission from the previous university for tranfer students A student who has studied in China and wants to transfer to another university must provide the permission from original university.

requirements.text: A Master Degree Certificate of Chinese Language & Literature or A Minimum HSK Result of Grade 6; Pass Tests of Professional Courses; Two Reference Letters from Two Associate Professors or Professionals with Higher Qualifications
